The '''Floridsdorfer Athletics Sports Club''' or simply '''Floridsdorfer AC''' or '''FAC''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Floridsdorf]], the 21st district of [[Vienna]]. The club was founded in August 1904.<ref>{{Cite web|title=History|url=https://fac.at/en/our-fac/history/|access-date=2021-06-24|website=FAC|language=en-US}}</ref> Floridsdorfer AC won the Austrian football championship in 1918 and are currently playing in the [[2. Liga (Austria)|Austrian 2. Liga]], the second tier of Austrian football. The club colours are blue and white.

[[File:Floridsdorfer Performance Graph.png|260px|thumb|Historical chart of Floridsdorfer AC league performance]]"}}
